Checked fixed bench left/tree right; limp→partly inflated→right extended→almost horizontal→diagonal left→left extended→limp→partly right sequence, including wide mouth orientation and narrow tail direction.

Checked fixed flashlight, mirror/screen arrangement, two light-path arrows, rightward spot, card blocking incoming path with spot on card and blank screen, lifted card, mirror return and restored screen spot.

Checked real red cube on blue block before capture, top camera button, moved cube beside block, triangular playback marker, unchanged saved stack versus side-by-side real blocks throughout the final views.

c.scope: All 80 proposed C21–C30 imageAlt/pageDescription pairs; author-source and images remain unchanged.
method: Read all 80 proposed descriptions and all current C21–C30 page reading texts and state fields.
Directly inspected all 80 illustrations on ten diagnostic sheets; each sheet hash and all 80 source image hashes match the bound author receipt.
Also opened six individual installed WebPs to inspect scanner placement/reflected light arrows, compass direction, cloud scattering arrows, oven core count and clock hands.
Checked object identities, states, counts, directions, prices, clock times and diagram meaning, and excluded generation or composition instructions.
observations: C21 bag tag, orange stripe and passenger/hold separation are retained; final collected suitcase is beside the belt.
C22 descriptions preserve fixed world directions as Kit turns; C23 describes the illustrated joint/muscle relationships without inventing invisible actions.
C24 identifies arrows and magnification as explanatory devices, including invisible vapor and separately illustrated ice-bearing cloud.
C25 descriptions retain the distinct open-switch and loose-clip breaks and the final closed, lit circuit.
C26 retains barcode identification, blank screen at data transfer, Cereal $3 on pages1/5 and Cereal $4 on pages6–8.
C27 preserves five cores/grooves/pencils and the joined boards; C28 describes only visible nest/animal/season states, without inventing fat diagrams.
C29 names the depicted clock times and relevant hand positions. C30 keeps engine feeds, exhaust/thrust directions and the gravity comparison distinct.
